label: Orman (Ajusco–Los Dinamos)
selection_method: Maximum inscribed circle / Euclidean distance transform peak inside the largest connected ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 class-10 (Tree cover) patch in the CDMX crop (lat 19.15-19.60, lon -99.30 to -98.85), snapped to the nearest NISAR 80 m UTM 14N pixel center so the 15x15 pixel (1.2 km x 1.2 km) box stays 100% inside both the crop and the forest patch.
source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 (10 m, collection esa-worldcover via Planetary Computer STAC; tiles N18W102 & N18W099)
